If someone enjoys a toner that contributes to how their skin actually behaves — not just how it smells or looks — this one has been a great addition.

avis.titre: Refreshing toner that boosts moisture instantly
avis.texte: One of the first things I noticed about the Fresh Rose Deep Hydration Toner was the texture. It has a lightweight, slightly silky feel with real rose petal pieces suspended in the formula, which makes the application feel very luxurious. I prefer applying it with my hands instead of a cotton pad to avoid wasting product, and it absorbs quickly without leaving any sticky or heavy residue. The scent is a soft, natural rose fragrance that feels fresh and calming without being overpowering, making it a really pleasant step in both my morning and evening routines. After using it consistently for a few weeks, I noticed my skin felt more hydrated and balanced overall. I have dry skin, and this toner helped prep my face nicely for the rest of my skincare products. My skin felt softer, more refreshed, and comfortably moisturized instead of tight. I also found that my makeup applied more smoothly since the extra hydration created a better base. The packaging is practical and durable as well—the bottle is made from hard plastic rather than glass, which makes it lightweight and easy to travel with. If your skin is on the drier side, I recommend applying two layers by gently patting it in for an extra hydration boost. I also like storing it in the fridge for a cooling effect in the mornings. Overall, it's a gentle and nourishing toner that has become a consistent step in my routine. Complimentary from freshbeauty.
